```
lemma measure_factorization' :
    ∃ (e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) ≃ᵐ
           FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
    ((MeasurePreserving e
      ((haarMeasurePositive N T L).prod ((haarMeasureNegative N T L).prod (haarMeasureInterface N T L)))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) ∧
    (∀ (x ...), restrictPosInterface N T L (e x) = mergePosInterface N T L x.1 x.2.2)) ∧
    (∀ (x ...) (idx : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
      (e x) ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ idx.1.1⟩ = x.2.1 idx)
```

```
finiteLinkIndexUnionSum (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) : FiniteLinkIndex Λ (s₁ ∪ s₂) ≃ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₁ ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₂
```

  88 | lemma measurable_reflectLinkVariable (N : ℕ) (T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] :
  89 |     Measurable (reflectLinkVariable N : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) := by
  90 |   -- Use measurable_comap_iff to reduce to the value map:
  91 |   -- reflectLinkVariable N is measurable into the comap space iff its value map is measurable
  92 |   -- into the product space.
  93 |   refine (measurable_comap_iff (g := fun (U' : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) => U'.value)).mpr ?_
  94 |   rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  95 |   intro n
  96 |   rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  97 |   intro μ
  98 |   simp [reflectLinkVariable]
  99 |   by_cases hμ : μ = 0
 100 |   · subst hμ
 101 |     -- Need to show Measurable (λ U => (U.value (ReflectSite.reflectSite n) 0)⁻¹)
 102 |     have h_val : Measurable (λ (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) =>
 103 |       U.value (ReflectSite.reflectSite n) 0) := by
 104 |       -- The map U ↦ U.value is measurable from the comap definition
 105 |       have h_value_map : Measurable (fun (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) => U.value) :=
 106 |         comap_measurable (fun (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) => U.value)
 107 |       -- Compose with coordinate projections
 108 |       have h_at_n : Measurable (λ (f : PeriodicSite T L → Fin 4 → SU N) => f (ReflectSite.reflectSite n)) :=
 109 |         measurable_pi_apply (ReflectSite.reflectSite n)
 110 |       have h_at_n_0 : Measurable (λ (f : Fin 4 → SU N) => f 0) := measurable_pi_apply (0 : Fin 4)
 111 |       exact h_at_n_0.comp (h_at_n.comp h_value_map)
 112 |     -- Inversion is continuous, hence measurable
 113 |     have h_inv : Measurable (λ (g : SU N) => g⁻¹) := (Continuous.inv continuous_id).measurable
 114 |     exact h_inv.comp h_val
 115 |   · -- μ ≠ 0, so U.value (θ n) μ (no inverse)
 116 |     have h_val : Measurable (λ (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) =>
 117 |       U.value (ReflectSite.reflectSite n) μ) := by
 118 |       have h_value_map : Measurable (fun (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) => U.value) :=
 119 |         comap_measurable (fun (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) => U.value)
 120 |       have h_at_n : Measurable (λ (f : PeriodicSite T L → Fin 4 → SU N) => f (ReflectSite.reflectSite n)) :=
 121 |         measurable_pi_apply (ReflectSite.reflectSite n)
 122 |       have h_at_n_μ : Measurable (λ (f : Fin 4 → SU N) => f μ) := measurable_pi_apply μ
 123 |       exact h_at_n_μ.comp (h_at_n.comp h_value_map)
 124 |     simpa [hμ] using h_val

 129 |   (positiveSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

 132 | noncomputable def negativeLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
 133 |   (negativeSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

 139 | lemma linkPartition_disjoint_union :
 140 |     positiveLinks T L ∪ negativeLinks T L ∪ interfaceLinks T L =
 141 |     (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4)) := by
 142 |   ext ⟨n, μ⟩; simp [positiveLinks, negativeLinks, interfaceLinks, positiveSites,
 143 |     negativeSites, interfaceSites]
 144 |   by_cases hpos : signedTime T n.time > 0
 145 |   · simp [hpos]
 146 |   · by_cases hneg : signedTime T n.time < 0
 147 |     · simp [hpos, hneg]
 148 |     · have hzero : signedTime T n.time = 0 := by
 149 |         have hle : signedTime T n.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
 150 |         have hge : signedTime T n.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
 151 |         linarith
 152 |       simp [hpos, hneg, hzero]

 154 | lemma linkPartition_disjoint :
 155 |     Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) ∧
 156 |     Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) ∧
 157 |     Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
 158 |   have h_pos_neg_sites : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (negativeSites T L) := by
 159 |     unfold positiveSites negativeSites
 160 |     rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
 161 |     intro n hn hpos hneg
 162 |     linarith
 163 |   have h_pos_int_sites : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
 164 |     unfold positiveSites interfaceSites
 165 |     rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
 166 |     intro n hn hpos hzero
 167 |     linarith
 168 |   have h_neg_int_sites : Disjoint (negativeSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
 169 |     unfold negativeSites interfaceSites
 170 |     rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
 171 |     intro n hn hneg hzero
 172 |     linarith
 173 |   have h_pos_neg_links : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) := by
 174 |     unfold positiveLinks negativeLinks
 175 |     simpa using (Finset.disjoint_product (s := positiveSites T L) (t := Finset.univ)
 176 |       (s' := negativeSites T L) (t' := Finset.univ)).mpr (Or.inl h_pos_neg_sites)
 177 |   have h_pos_int_links : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
 178 |     unfold positiveLinks interfaceLinks
 179 |     simpa using (Finset.disjoint_product (s := positiveSites T L) (t := Finset.univ)
 180 |       (s' := interfaceSites T L) (t' := Finset.univ)).mpr (Or.inl h_pos_int_sites)
 181 |   have h_neg_int_links : Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
 182 |     unfold negativeLinks interfaceLinks
 183 |     simpa using (Finset.disjoint_product (s := negativeSites T L) (t := Finset.univ)
 184 |       (s' := interfaceSites T L) (t' := Finset.univ)).mpr (Or.inl h_neg_int_sites)
 185 |   exact ⟨h_pos_neg_links, h_pos_int_links, h_neg_int_links⟩

 188 | lemma sites_cover (T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] :
 189 |     (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ := by
 190 |   ext n; simp [positiveSites, negativeSites, interfaceSites]
 191 |   by_cases hpos : signedTime T n.time > 0
 192 |   · simp [hpos]
 193 |   · by_cases hneg : signedTime T n.time < 0
 194 |     · simp [hpos, hneg]
 195 |     · have hzero : signedTime T n.time = 0 := by
 196 |         have hle : signedTime T n.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
 197 |         have hge : signedTime T n.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
 198 |         linarith
 199 |       simp [hpos, hneg, hzero]

 213 | /-- A helper equivalence: `FiniteLinkIndex Λ (s₁ ∪ s₂) ≃ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₁ ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₂`
 214 | for disjoint s₁, s₂. -/
 215 | noncomputable def finiteLinkIndexUnionSum {Λ : Type} [DecidableEq Λ] {s₁ s₂ : Finset Λ}
 216 |     (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) : FiniteLinkIndex Λ (s₁ ∪ s₂) ≃ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₁ ⊕ FiniteLinkIndex Λ s₂ where
 217 |   toFun := λ x =>
 218 |     if h₁ : x.1.1 ∈ s₁ then
 219 |       Sum.inl ⟨(x.1.1, x.1.2), h₁⟩
 220 |     else
 221 |       have h₂ : x.1.1 ∈ s₂ := by
 222 |         rcases Finset.mem_union.mp x.2 with (h₁' | h₂')
 223 |         · exact (h₁ h₁').elim
 224 |         · exact h₂'
 225 |       Sum.inr ⟨(x.1.1, x.1.2), h₂⟩
 226 |   invFun := λ y => match y with
 227 |     | Sum.inl ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩ => ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_left s₂ hn⟩
 228 |     | Sum.inr ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩ => ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_right s₁ hn⟩
 229 |   left_inv := by
 230 |     intro x
 231 |     apply Subtype.ext
 232 |     by_cases h₁ : x.1.1 ∈ s₁
 233 |     · simp [h₁]
 234 |     · have h₂ : x.1.1 ∈ s₂ := by
 235 |         rcases Finset.mem_union.mp x.2 with (h₁' | h₂')
 236 |         · exact (h₁ h₁').elim
 237 |         · exact h₂'
 238 |       simp [h₁, h₂]
 239 |   right_inv := by
 240 |     intro y
 241 |     rcases y with (⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩ | ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩)
 242 |     · -- Sum.inl case: hn : (n, μ).1 ∈ s₁, i.e. n ∈ s₁
 243 |       simp [hn]
 244 |     · -- Sum.inr case: hn : (n, μ).1 ∈ s₂, i.e. n ∈ s₂, and s₁, s₂ are disjoint
 245 |       have hn' : n ∉ s₁ := by
 246 |         intro hn1
 247 |         have h_disj : s₁ ∩ s₂ = ∅ := Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp h
 248 |         have mem_inter : n ∈ s₁ ∩ s₂ := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hn1, hn⟩
 249 |         rw [h_disj] at mem_inter
 250 |         simpa using mem_inter
 251 |       simp [hn']

 253 | /-- The product Haar measure on FiniteLinkConfig is Measure.pi on the FiniteLinkIndex type,
 254 | and we can move between FiniteLinkIndex and the product Finset via a bijection. -/
 255 | noncomputable def finiteLinkIndexEquiv (Λ : Type) [DecidableEq Λ] (sites : Finset Λ) :
 256 |     FiniteLinkIndex Λ sites ≃ (sites.product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))) where
 257 |   toFun := λ x =>
 258 |     let n := x.1.1; let μ := x.1.2; let hn : n ∈ sites := x.2
 259 |     ⟨(n, μ), by simp [hn, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ]⟩
 260 |   invFun := λ y =>
 261 |     let n := y.1.1; let μ := y.1.2
 262 |     have hn : n ∈ sites := by
 263 |       rcases Finset.mem_product.mp y.2 with ⟨hn, hμ⟩
 264 |       exact hn
 265 |     ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩
 266 |   left_inv := by
 267 |     intro x
 268 |     let n := x.1.1; let μ := x.1.2; let hn : n ∈ sites := x.2
 269 |     rfl
 270 |   right_inv := by
 271 |     intro y
 272 |     let n := y.1.1; let μ := y.1.2
 273 |     rcases Finset.mem_product.mp y.2 with ⟨hn, hμ⟩
 274 |     rfl

 276 | /-- The configuration space for positive and interface links together. -/
 277 | abbrev PosInterfaceConfig :=
 278 |   FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L)

 280 | /-- Restriction of a full configuration to the positive and interface links. -/
 281 | noncomputable def restrictPosInterface (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
 282 |     PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
 283 |   λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1)⟩
 284 | 
 285 | /-- Merging a positive configuration and an interface configuration. -/
 286 | noncomputable def mergePosInterface
 287 |     (U_plus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
 288 |     (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
 289 |     PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
 290 |   λ idx =>
 291 |     match idx with
 292 |     | ⟨(n, μ), hmem⟩ =>
 293 |       if h : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
 294 |         U_plus ⟨(n, μ), h⟩
 295 |       else
 296 |         have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
 297 |           rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hmem with (hpos | hint)
 298 |           · exact (h hpos).elim
 299 |           · exact hint
 300 |         U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩

 302 | lemma measure_factorization' :
 303 |     ∃ (e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
 304 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
 305 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) ≃ᵐ
 306 |            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
 307 |     ((MeasurePreserving e
 308 |       ((haarMeasurePositive N T L).prod ((haarMeasureNegative N T L).prod (haarMeasureInterface N T L)))
 309 |       (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) ∧
 310 |     (∀ (x : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
 311 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
 312 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)),
 313 |       restrictPosInterface N T L (e x) = mergePosInterface N T L x.1 x.2.2)) ∧
 314 |     (∀ (x : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
 315 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
 316 |             FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L))
 317 |       (idx : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
 318 |       (e x) ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ idx.1.1⟩ = x.2.1 idx)) := by
 319 |   -- Forward map: merge all three configs based on site classification
 320 |   let mergeAll (x : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
 321 |                   FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
 322 |                   FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
 323 |       FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :=
 324 |     λ idx =>
 325 |       let n := idx.1.1; let μ := idx.1.2
 326 |       if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
 327 |         x.1 ⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩
 328 |       else if hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L then
 329 |         x.2.1 ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩
 330 |       else
 331 |         have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
 332 |           have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ :=
 333 |             sites_cover T L
 334 |           have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := idx.2
 335 |           have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
 336 |             rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
 337 |           rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h_mem with (h | h)
 338 |           · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with (h' | h')
 339 |             · exfalso; exact hpos h'
 340 |             · exfalso; exact hneg h'
 341 |           · exact h
 342 |         x.2.2 ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩
 343 |   -- Inverse map: split a full config into three parts by restriction
 344 |   let splitAll (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
 345 |       FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
 346 |       FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
 347 |       FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L) :=
 348 |     ( (λ (idx : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)) =>
 349 |         cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ idx.1.1⟩),
 350 |       (λ (idx : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) =>
 351 |         cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ idx.1.1⟩),
 352 |       (λ (idx : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) =>
 353 |         cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ idx.1.1⟩) )
 354 |   have h_disjoint_pos_neg : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (negativeSites T L) :=
 355 |     (linkPartition_disjoint T L).1
 356 |   have h_disjoint_pos_int : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) :=
 357 |     (linkPartition_disjoint T L).2.1
 358 |   have h_disjoint_neg_int : Disjoint (negativeSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) :=
 359 |     (linkPartition_disjoint T L).2.2
 360 |   have h_left_inv : ∀ x, splitAll (mergeAll x) = x := by
 361 |     intro x
 362 |     apply Prod.ext
 363 |     · -- first component (positive sites)
 364 |       ext idx
 365 |       rcases idx with ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩
 366 |       dsimp [splitAll, mergeAll]
 367 |       have hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L := hn
 368 |       simp [hpos]
 369 |     · -- second × third component
 370 |       apply Prod.ext
 371 |       · -- second component (negative sites)
 372 |         ext idx
 373 |         rcases idx with ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩
 374 |         dsimp [splitAll, mergeAll]
 375 |         have hpos : n ∉ positiveSites T L := by
 376 |           intro h; exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp h_disjoint_pos_neg h hn
 377 |         have hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L := hn
 378 |         simp [hpos, hneg]
 379 |       · -- third component (interface sites)
 380 |         ext idx
 381 |         rcases idx with ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩
 382 |         dsimp [splitAll, mergeAll]
 383 |         have hpos : n ∉ positiveSites T L := by
 384 |           intro h; exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp h_disjoint_pos_int h hn
 385 |         have hneg : n ∉ negativeSites T L := by
 386 |           intro h; exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp h_disjoint_neg_int h hn
 387 |         simp [hpos, hneg, hn]
 388 |   have h_right_inv : ∀ cfg, mergeAll (splitAll cfg) = cfg := by
 389 |     intro cfg
 390 |     ext idx
 391 |     rcases idx with ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩
 392 |     dsimp [mergeAll, splitAll]
 393 |     by_cases hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L
 394 |     · simp [hpos]
 395 |     · by_cases hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L
 396 |       · simp [hpos, hneg]
 397 |       · have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
 398 |           have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ :=
 399 |             sites_cover T L
 400 |           have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
 401 |           have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
 402 |             rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
 403 |           rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h_mem with (h | h)
 404 |           · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with (h' | h')
 405 |             · exfalso; exact hpos h'
 406 |             · exfalso; exact hneg h'
 407 |           · exact h
 408 |         simp [hpos, hneg, hint]
 409 |   have h_meas_mergeAll : Measurable mergeAll := by
 410 |     rw [measurable_pi_iff]; intro idx
 411 |     rcases idx with ⟨⟨n, μ⟩, hn⟩
 412 |     dsimp [mergeAll]
 413 |     by_cases hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L
 414 |     · have h_proj : (λ x => mergeAll x ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩) = (λ x => x.1 ⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩) := by
 415 |         ext x; simp [mergeAll, hpos]
 416 |       rw [h_proj]
 417 |       exact measurable_pi_apply (⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
 418 |     · by_cases hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L
 419 |       · have h_proj : (λ x => mergeAll x ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩) = (λ x => x.2.1 ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩) := by
 420 |           ext x; simp [mergeAll, hpos, hneg]
 421 |         rw [h_proj]
 422 |         refine (measurable_pi_apply (⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))).comp ?_
 423 |         exact measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd
 424 |       · have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
 425 |           have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ :=
 426 |             sites_cover T L
 427 |           have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
 428 |           have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
 429 |             rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
 430 |           rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h_mem with (h | h)
 431 |           · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with (h' | h')
 432 |             · exfalso; exact hpos h'
 433 |             · exfalso; exact hneg h'
 434 |           · exact h
 435 |         have h_proj : (λ x => mergeAll x ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩) = (λ x => x.2.2 ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩) := by
 436 |           ext x; simp [mergeAll, hpos, hneg, hint]
 437 |         rw [h_proj]
 438 |         refine (measurable_pi_apply (⟨(n, μ), hint⟩ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L))).comp ?_
 439 |         exact measurable_snd.comp measurable_snd
 440 |   have h_meas_splitAll : Measurable splitAll := by
 441 |     refine Measurable.prod ?_ (Measurable.prod ?_ ?_)

 650 | /--
 651 |   The reflection map θ⁻⁰ from negative+interface configurations to
 652 |   positive+interface configurations.
 653 | 
 654 |   Given (U⁻, U⁰), we construct a full configuration where positive links are
 655 |   set to 1, U⁻ on negative links, and U⁰ on interface links.  Then we apply
 656 |   the full geometric reflection θ and restrict the result to the
 657 |   positive+interface region.  Since θ maps negative links to positive links
 658 |   and interface links to themselves, the result depends only on U⁻ and U⁰.
 659 | -/
 660 | noncomputable def reflectToPosInterface
 661 |     (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
 662 |     (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
 663 |     PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
 664 |   -- Combine identity on positive links with U_zero on interface links
 665 |   let U_plus_zero_zeroed : PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
 666 |     λ idx =>
 667 |       match idx with
 668 |       | ⟨(n, μ), hmem⟩ =>
 669 |         if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then 1
 670 |         else
 671 |           have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
 672 |             rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hmem with (hpos' | hint')
 673 |             · exact (hpos hpos').elim
 674 |             · exact hint'
 675 |           U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩
 676 |   -- Merge with U_minus to get a full config, then reflect and restrict
 677 |   let full_cfg := mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero_zeroed
 678 |   let full_link := extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) full_cfg
 679 |   let reflected_link := reflectLinkVariable N full_link

 685 | noncomputable def restrictToInterface (u : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
 686 |     FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L) :=

 689 | /--
 690 |   Compute S_OS⁺(U⁺,U⁰) from a positive+interface configuration.
 691 |   Since S_OS⁺ only involves positive-time plaquettes (all four corners > 0),
 692 |   it depends only on the positive+interface part of the configuration.
 693 |   The value does not depend on how negative links are set.
 694 | -/
 695 | noncomputable def osPositiveOfPosInterface (u : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
 696 |   let full_link := extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) u
 697 |   wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β full_link

 699 | /--
 700 |   The correct transfer matrix T acting on functions ψ : PosInterfaceConfig → ℝ.
 701 | 
 702 |   (T ψ)(u) = ∫ ψ(θ⁻⁰(U⁻, u⁰))
 703 |               · exp(-β·(S_OS⁺(u)/2 + S_OS⁻(U⁻)/2 + S_OS_int(u, U⁻)))
 704 |               dμ⁻(U⁻)
 705 | 
 706 |   where u = (U⁺, U⁰) and the integral kernel is chosen so that the key identity holds:
 707 | 
 708 |     g(u)·(T g)(u) = ∫ G(U)·G(θU) dμ⁻(U⁻)
 709 | 
 710 |   with g(u) = f(u)·exp(-β·S_OS⁺(u)/2).
 711 | -/
 712 | noncomputable def transferMatrixCorrect (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ)
 713 |     (u : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
 714 |   let S_plus := osPositiveOfPosInterface N T L β u
 715 |   ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
 716 |     ψ (reflectToPosInterface N T L U_minus (restrictToInterface N T L u)) *
 717 |     Real.exp (-β * (S_plus / 2 +
 718 |                     wilsonActionOSNegative N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus u) / 2 +
 719 |                     wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus u)))
 720 |     ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L
 721 | /-- The function G(U) = f(U)·exp(-β·S_OS⁺(U))·exp(-β·S_OS_int(U)/2)
 722 | 
 723 |   This is the key building block for the Osterwalder-Seiler reflection positivity proof.
 724 |   For a function f depending only on positive+interface links, G(U)·G(θU) factors through
 725 |   the transfer matrix. -/
 726 | noncomputable def G (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ) (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ)
 727 |     (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) : ℝ :=
 728 |   f U * Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β U) *
 729 |     Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β U / 2)
 730 | 
 731 | /-- The function g(u) = f(u)·exp(-β·S_OS⁺(u)/2) for u ∈ PosInterfaceConfig.
 732 | 
 733 |   This is the positive+interface reduction of G.  The extra factor of 1/2 in the
 734 |   exponential (compared to G) ensures that G(U)·G(θU) factorizes as
 735 |   g(U⁺,U⁰)·g(θ⁻⁰(U⁻,U⁰))·exp(-β·(S_OS⁻(U⁻)+S_OS_int(U))/2). -/
 736 | noncomputable def g_posInterface (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)
 737 |     (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ)
 738 |     (u : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
 739 |   f (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) u) *
 740 |     Real.exp (-β * osPositiveOfPosInterface N T L β u / 2)
